<BEGIN_SHACL>
@prefix sh: <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .
@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
@prefix qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/> .
@prefix vocab: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#> .
@prefix ex: <http://example.org/> .

# Shape targeting all ships (the admitted synthetic population)
ex:ShipScantlingShape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:targetClass vocab:ship ;

    # Ice strengthening status (boolean) – optional but used in the conditional rule
    sh:property [
        sh:path vocab:iceStrengtheningStatus ;
        sh:datatype xsd:boolean ;
        sh:name "Ice strengthening status" ;
        sh:description "True if the ship is ice‑strengthened, false otherwise." ;
    ] ;

    # Regulation‑derived scantling (QuantityValue)
    sh:property [
        sh:path vocab:regulationRequiredScantling ;
        sh:class qudt:QuantityValue ;
        sh:name "Regulation required scantling" ;
        sh:description "Scantlings obtained from the Ice Class Regulations." ;
    ] ;

    # Classification‑society required scantling for a non‑ice‑strengthened ship (QuantityValue)
    sh:property [
        sh:path vocab:classificationSocietyRequiredScantling ;
        sh:class qudt:QuantityValue ;
        sh:name "Classification‑society required scantling" ;
        sh:description "Scantlings required by the classification society for a ship without ice strengthening." ;
    ] ;

    # Selected design scantling (QuantityValue) – the value that must satisfy the rule
    sh:property [
        sh:path vocab:selectedDesignScantling ;
        sh:class qudt:QuantityValue ;
        sh:name "Selected design scantling" ;
        sh:description "The scantling actually used in the ship design." ;
    ] ;

    # Conditional SPARQL constraint enforcing the requirement:
    # If the ship is NOT ice‑strengthened (iceStrengtheningStatus = false) and the
    # regulation‑derived scantling is less than the classification‑society scantling,
    # then the selected design scantling must be at least the classification‑society required scantling.
    sh:sparql [
        a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;
        sh:message "For a non‑ice‑strengthened ship, the selected design scantling must be ≥ the classification‑society required scantling." ;
        sh:prefixes [
            sh:declare [
                sh:prefix "vocab" ;
                sh:namespace "https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#" ;
            ] ;
            sh:declare [
                sh:prefix "qudt" ;
                sh:namespace "http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/" ;
            ] ;
            sh:declare [
                sh:prefix "xsd" ;
                sh:namespace "http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#" ;
            ] ;
        ] ;
        sh:select """ 
            SELECT $this
            WHERE {
                # Retrieve ice‑strengthening status (if present)
                OPTIONAL { $this vocab:iceStrengtheningStatus ?iceStatus . }

                # Retrieve regulation‑derived scantling and its numeric value
                OPTIONAL {
                    $this vocab:regulationRequiredScantling ?regScantling .
                    ?regScantling qudt:numericValue ?regVal .
                    OPTIONAL { ?regScantling qudt:unit ?regUnit . }
                }

                # Retrieve classification‑society scantling and its numeric value
                OPTIONAL {
                    $this vocab:classificationSocietyRequiredScantling ?clsScantling .
                    ?clsScantling qudt:numericValue ?clsVal .
                    OPTIONAL { ?clsScantling qudt:unit ?clsUnit . }
                }

                # Retrieve selected design scantling and its numeric value
                OPTIONAL {
                    $this vocab:selectedDesignScantling ?selScantling .
                    ?selScantling qudt:numericValue ?selVal .
                    OPTIONAL { ?selScantling qudt:unit ?selUnit . }
                }

                # Apply the rule only when iceStrengtheningStatus is explicitly false
                FILTER ( bound(?iceStatus) && ?iceStatus = false )

                # Both classification‑society and selected scantlings must be present for the check
                FILTER ( bound(?clsVal) && bound(?selVal) )

                # Ensure unit compatibility (if units are present they must match)
                FILTER ( (!bound(?regUnit) || !bound(?clsUnit) || ?regUnit = ?clsUnit) )
                FILTER ( (!bound(?selUnit) || !bound(?clsUnit) || ?selUnit = ?clsUnit) )

                # If regulation scantling is less than classification‑society scantling,
                # enforce selected ≥ classification‑society
                FILTER ( (!bound(?regVal) || ?regVal >= ?clsVal) ||
                         (bound(?regVal) && ?regVal < ?clsVal && ?selVal >= ?clsVal) )
            }
        """ ;
        sh:severity sh:Violation ;
    ] .
</END_SHACL>
